title: Cipher and Witness
author: T. M. Crane
blurb: Kestrel Marchetti, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
